items.title: Analysts Just Sounded the Alarm on These 5 Overhyped Stocks
items.summary: Wall Street had a rough week, and the damage came fast. Thursday’s sell-off erased $2.3 trillion in market value, pushed the Nasdaq into a correction and sent the VIX, the market’s fear gauge, up 70% to 28, Yahoo Finance reported on November 6. A chip-sector index that plunged 12% on Thursday bounced 4% the next […]
